## Accepted (Inline — doc drift, triage rule 1)

### OOS_1: `SECURITY.md` undercounts emergency Preflight bypasses
- **Disposition**: Folded inline per OOS triage rule 1 (documentation drift — SECURITY.md had wrong count of --emergency bypass gates)
- **Fix**: Updated SECURITY.md to document four Preflight downgrade gates (was three; missing-designed-prefix admission bypass was undocumented)
- **Inline-triage rule 1**: SECURITY.md emergency bypass count corrected from three to four gates
- **Phase**: implement
- **Reviewer(s)**: codex-specialist-correctness-output.txt, codex-specialist-edge-cases-output.txt, dyn-architecture-output.txt, dyn-architecture-codex-output.txt
